name: Gwythyr fab Greidawl

attributes.attribute: He was one of two suitors for Creiddylad, the maiden of springtime.
In Beltane ceremonies he represented summer.
He always won, defeating the winter king Gwynn ap Nudd.
Eternal combatant with Gwyn ap Nudd.
Abducted Creiddylad and beat Gwythyr's rescue force.
Condemned the two to fight each May Day until the end of time.
The day each year on which the two men fight.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gwythyr fab Greidawl is an eternal combatant in Welsh tradition. The name can be read as victor, son of the scorcher. He was the intended husband of Creiddylad, the beautiful daughter of Lludd Llaw Ereint. Gwyn ap Nudd carried off Creiddylad before the two could marry. Gwyn defeated the force that came to rescue Gwythyr's bride. The captives of Gwythyr were treated very savagely. So bitter was the hatred that Arthur condemned the two men to fight each May Day until the end of time. Each Calan Mai, or May Day, the two renew their combat.

okr.objective: Present Gwythyr fab Greidawl as the Welsh combatant who fights Gwyn ap Nudd each May Day for Creiddylad.
key_results: Gwythyr is the intended husband of Creiddylad
Gwyn ap Nudd abducted her before the marriage
Arthur condemned the two to fight each May Day forever
